Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap With the emotional in-game closure on Dawntrail's story now having come and gone, the final leg of Final Fantasy 14 's Fanfest circuit has arrived in Tokyo with plenty more information to share on the upcoming Evercold expansion.

While details about the revamped gameplay, character customization, and Evercold's second combat job are some of the hottest topics on the stage, the biggest question is, of course, when exactly the expansion will drop.

From its gorgeous graphics to its timeless gameplay, here are ten reasons you need to play Final Fantasy Resonance right now.

Thanks to director Yoshi-P's opening keynote, Warriors of Light around the world now have a date to pencil in on their calendars. Or rather, there are a few dates to remember.

After showing off the final version of the trailer at the top of the keynote, Final Fantasy 14 director Naoki ("Yoshi-P") promptly announced that the Evercold expansion will now arrive a few weeks later on February 23, 2027 .

The reason for this, he explained, is that with all the major gameplay changes happening in Evercold (8.0), certain aspects of the development process took more time than initially anticipated, and he made the executive decision to implement an extension to ensure that the expansion will be truly polished for launch.

Initially, the game would have been "just barely" ready for the original launch date, but after finding several issues that still need addressing and to "bring the game to a level of quality we're satisfied with", the delay was necessary. After apologizing profusely, he assured that there would be no further delays beyond this February date.

However, for those who preorder the Evercold expansion, you'll be able to get in a few days early via its Early Access version on February 19, 2027 . As to how extensive that Early Access will be for players to explore, that wasn't clarified during the keynote, but more details will likely be revealed in a future Producer Live Letter livestream, as Yoshi-P said there will be several PLLs to go over everything in meticulous detail leading up to Evercold's launch.

Furthermore, Yoshi-P noted that an Evercold Benchmark test will become available sometime in December , allowing PC players in particular to test the specs of their current setups ahead of the expansion's launch, to ensure that the launch will be smooth sailing. As for the actual required PC system specs, those were not revealed in the Tokyo keynote.

Along with a concrete release date for the Evercold expansion, Yoshi-P has also announced when players will be able to place their pre-orders for all versions and platforms. Preorders will go live in just under a week on November 4, 2027 , on the official Square Enix website along with the respective websites for each major platform (Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2).

Near the end of the keynote, Yoshi-P took the opportunity to review the physical Collector's Edition once again, showing the audience all the goodies included with the bundle.

At the forefront is, of course, the impressively detailed statue fashioned in the likeness of the Warrior of Light as a Reaper. Alongside that are a woven tapestry banner of the Fourth and two keychains. On top of all that, players will also get three different in-game items, including the Valhallar Odin Mount (a Final Fantasy 13 throwback), the Entreat Crystal Emote, and a set of Crystal Skyltborg weapons for Bastion.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold Gets February 2027 Release Date
items.summary: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold launches on February 23, 2027, with early access starting February 19 for eligible players who pre-order the expansion.
items.content:
Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold will launch on February 23, 2027, with early access beginning four days earlier on February 19 for eligible players who pre-order the expansion. Square Enix confirmed the release date through the MMORPG’s official account , with pre-orders scheduled to open on November 4, 2026.

Evercold is the sixth major expansion for Final Fantasy XIV and takes players to the icebound realm of the Fourth. It raises the level cap to 110 and introduces two new jobs: Bastion, a tank, and Zephyr, a physical ranged DPS job.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evolves With Evercold In February 2027
items.summary: Final Fantasy XIV's Fan Festival in Tokyo is in full swing, and we now know we'll be heading to the Fourth in Evercold, come February 2027.
items.content:
Gaming Final Fantasy XIV Evolves With Evercold In February 2027 Throwing Down A Gauntlet CGMagazine Follow Chris de Hoog Updated Sat, October 31, 2026 at 5:40 AM UTC Updated Sat, October 31, 2026 at 5:40 AM UTC *]:pointer-events-auto hidden md:block"> Final Fantasy XIV Evolves With Evercold In February 2027 - Photo: CGMagazine Final Fantasy XIV 's world tour of Fan Festival events has reached its final destination in Japan, and producer Naoki Yoshida truly pulled back the curtain on Evercold in the opening keynote.

The next expansion was announced at the Fan Fest in Anaheim in April, and tentatively aimed to release in January. However, despite the team's best efforts, Yoshida personally made the call to defer launch by a couple weeks. Early access for Final Fantasy XIV 's next era will begin on February 19, 2027, with the full proper release following on February 23. (Preorders, however, open next week on November 4.)

The third and final version of Evercold 's trailer debuted, showing the second new class being added in this expansion. This is a physical ranged DPS class dubbed Zephyr, where players will fight with a crossbow and "an avian familiar" called a Nephele. Starting at level 90, the Zephyr's origins trace back to Ilsabard, and their playstyle is very mobile and evasive.

Yoshida then provided a glimpse at the new characters and settings that will feature as players journey to the Fourth. Alongside Visna, the new character with the Zephyr class, is a familiar person named Lagertha who looks an awful lot like Ysayle from Heavensward . Meanwhile it appears Alphinaud and Estinien are our only fellow Scions making the journey with us, while Halmarut and Calyx still have roles to play.

Evercold 's new areas revolve around the Realmships, massive airships that represent the elements and house the Fourth's inhabitants, since the surface is covered in ice and inhabitable. Yoshida revealed the remaining Realmships-Sessrymnir, Realmship of Earth and Skidbladnir, Tealmship of Wind. The latter is where the Kettir cat-folk live, and Yoshida teased that their homeland upon the ship is "very, very, very" cute. In-universe, it's been five hundred years since civilization took to the sky, and there's been next to no contact between the Realmships, so each has evolved separately from there.

On the gameplay side, Yoshida ran through the changes coming to Final Fantasy XIV 's progression systems. As announced at the Anaheim Fan Fest in April, the MMORPG is shifting its focus from daily to weekly progression, to grant players the freedom to find their own pace or to avoid "punishing" people for not playing daily.

Updated mockups of the new Adventurer Activity screen were shown (see above), with Yoshida remarking that the room behind the character on this screen may be made customizable down the line. While it may resemble some paid season pass system, Yoshida vehemently promised that the game is not instituting "seasons" in terms of paid season passes, but simply as a means of tracking progress over updates. Completing repeatable or weekly missions (up to and including work on your Disciples of the Land or Hand classes) grants points that fill the meter on-screen. Once the meter hits the appropriate landmarks, players will receive rewards like gear and the specific means to upgrade that gear.

2 types of gear can be optimized each season through this menu. The first is Seasonal gear, which is intended for everyday players. Players obtain this tier by playing and raising their activity level. The second level is Raid gear, the best variety in the game. Raid gear will take more effort and resources, such as upgrades from new 8-player Savage-difficulty raids, but they offer customizable secondary abilities. Those who manage to fully optimize a complete, matching set will gain further enhancements.

Speaking of customization, Yoshida mentioned that the Evercold benchmark software will drop soon for PC players to test their machines and verify their settings. The built-in character creation tool will allow experimentation with the new appearance customizations tools detailed at Anaheim.

In one of the Keynote's more shocking revelations, Yoshida announced a radical reconfiguration of the 24-player Alliance Raids. These specific trials will be split in half into separate duties, reducing how demanding they can be upon players's time. Once a player has beaten the raid at least once, they can then choose to queue up for only their desired half if they're seeking something specific. Plus, Yoshida pledged that " the days of casting lots [for loot items] over and over, are over ."

Final Fantasy XIV will receive new battle content called the Gauntlet of Power, where parties do battle without level sync forcing players to go up or down to match the others. Instead, Square Enix's new Auto Content Balancing system will adjust the difficulty of encounters to each players' level, allowing them to participate at their level with all their hard-earned skills. The Gauntlet of Power is a dungeon boss rush mode, with up to 5 bosses challenged in secession. Opponents are picked based on the party's individual progresses-meaning Final Fantasy XIV players need not fear having an upcoming boss being spoiled.

Those who use Final Fantasy XIV 's Duty Support feature often may be relieved to learn that the feature will now fill gaps in your party accordingly. Players can bring a friend or two in with them, and the computer will fill the remaining party slots. Other major updates planned for after Evercold 's launch include a Hall of the Novice for PvP, overhauls to housing, and the long-awaited adjustment for companion chcocobs.

Yoshida's keystream culminated with further teases for Evercold 's big raid series. The first, a crossover with Final Fantasy VII called "Beyond the Lifestream," will get its first installment in patch 8.0.1, and Yoshida showed off some original art by Tetsuya Nomura featuring Cloud, Sephiroth, and Final Fantasy XIV 's poster boy Warrior of Light.

The other raid series, Evangelion: Ghosts of Desire raid series kicks off in patch 8.1. Luckily this time Yoshida was able to show some actual footage, albeit it spliced to look and sound like an episode preview, narrated by Neon Genesis Evangelion 's Misato. It's still surreal to consider the two properties crossing over in this way, but nonetheless, the next era is beginning to really shape up for Square Enix's long-running MMORPG

items.title: Did FFXIV Just Tease A Valkyrie Profile Crossover?
items.summary: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold teases a potential Valkyrie Profile crossover as Lenneth appears during the Tokyo Fan Festival keynote.
items.content:
The upcoming expansion to Final Fantasy XIV , titled Evercold , is very heavily themed after Norse mythology, and curious players have already combed through the various trailers and locale teasers for theories about how the game will integrate familiar elements from Norse stories of old. But then, during today’s Tokyo Fan Festival keynote, Director/Producer Yoshi-P mentioned that players may be fighting foes like what we see onscreen…and then dropped the above image, with no further context.

It’s not unheard of that a Norse-themed expansion would feature the vague concept of “valkyries”, female fighters of legend who return from the afterlife to continue to do glorious battle, but this is no generic image of a female warrior – this is Lenneth, the main heroine of the original Valkyrie Profile title.

Square Enix (then Enix) published Valkyrie Profile in 1999 for the original PlayStation console, with the game having later been ported to the PSP in 2006 and then modern platforms over the last few years. The game stars Lenneth, a valkyrie sent to gather the souls of potential allies amongst the soon-to-be-dead living. The most recent title in the series, Valkyrie Elysium , released in 2022.

While Lenneth’s appearance in the game may well be as minor as a single boss fight, this could be a sign of more integration of its lore into Evercold , with this being the second non- Final Fantasy series to officially be permanently represented in Final Fantasy XIV after the expansion long crossover with NieR in the Shadowbringers expansion. Evercold launches in Early Access on February 19, so we’ll have our answers soon.

Stay tuned for more Evercold news as it’s revealed!

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed Till February 2027
Final Fantasy 14: Evercold gets February launch date
items.summary: A lot of new information is coming out of Final Fantasy 14 Fan Fest Japan 2026.
items.content:
News Final Fantasy 14: Evercold gets February launch date A lot of new information is coming out of Final Fantasy 14 Fan Fest Japan 2026.

Square Enix is celebrating all things Final Fantasy 14 Online in Japan this weekend. With Final Fantasy 14 Fan Fest Japan kicking off, Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida took the stage for the event's keynote with some new information, including the official release date for the upcoming Evercold expansion. Final Fantasy 14: Evercold is now set to launch in February 2027 with pre-orders set to go live next week.

FINAL FANTASY XIV: Evercold is scheduled to launch on Tuesday, February 23, 2027! Pre-order starting Wednesday, November 4, 2026 to be eligible for early access beginning Friday, February 19, 2027! [image or embed]

Final Fantasy 14: Evercold is scheduled to launch on February 23, 2027 with early access available starting on February 19, 2027 , which is a slight delay from the initial January 2027 release window that Square Enix has put out. Along with the new release date, Yoshida revealed some never-before-seen footage of the upcoming expansion. He also unveiled the game's next new job, the Zephyr. The Zephyr is a ranged DPS character who fights with a crossbow and a trusty avian familiar. In addition, players got to check out some of the expansion's new characters and new areas, including Sessyrmnir, Realmship of Earth. Sessyrmnir is described as one of the Fourth's five massive airships, one so big that its surface is practically a world in itself with settlements and fields.

This is only a small taste of what's coming to Final Fantasy 14: Evercold. As of this post, Yoshida's keynote is ongoing, so it's likely he'll have plenty more to show off. Look for Final Fantasy 14: Evercold to come to all of Final Fantasy 14 Online's platforms, including the newly released Nintendo Switch 2 version . Pre-orders for Evercold are set to begin on Wednesday, November 4 .

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed, New Release Date Announced at FFXIV Fan Fest
items.summary: The MMORPG's next expansion was set to launch shortly after the new year, but Warriors of Light will have to wait a bit longer.
items.content:
Final Fantasy XIV Evercold was set to launch sometime in January 2027, which was announced as part of its initial reveal back in April this year during the North American FFXIV Fan Fest. However, this next expansion for the critically acclaimed MMORPG has been delayed – FFXIV Evercold's release date is now February 23, 2027 (and February 19, 2027 for early access). This was announced alongside the new, full trailer / intro cinematic for Evercold at FFXIV Fan Fest in Japan, and was said to only be a four-week delay.

In typical FFXIV fashion, the third and final teaser trailer is the full opening cinematic for an expansion, and it kicked off the Japan Fan Fest keynote where director and producer Naoki Yoshida presented more details on new features, where the ongoing story is headed, and fundemental gameplay changes as FFXIV goes into version 8.0 alongside Evercold's launch.

Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 and will come with several bonus items, which will be revealed later in the Fan Fest keynote - I will update this as they are shown. Additionally, we got a glimpse of the second new Job coming to his new expansion. It's a ranged DPS called Zephyr, which rocks a crossbow as their primary weapon and commands an avian companion to provide support.

There's a lot coming to FFXIV Evercold in addition to a new world and main story including a Neon Genesis Evangelion crossover raid series , a Final Fantasy VII crossover raid series, a new Tank Job with Bastion, and much more. Be sure to check out my Dawntrail review as well to look back at the last expansion before heading into this new era for FFXIV.

items.title: The Daily Grind: What are you hoping to see from tonight’s Final Fantasy XIV Fan Festival keynote?
How to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in FFXIV
items.content:
By Paulo Kawanishi Published Oct 28, 2026, 1:50 PM EDT Guides How fast can you type "Nibelheim"?

Image: Square Enix via Polygon Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Summary Generate a summary of this story Jump links Jump Links How to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in FFXIV How to start the Keybound Brawler event in FFXIV All FFXIV Keybound Brawler rewards Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Tifa and Barret's outfits are the real stars in Final Fantasy 14 ' s event in the Keybound Brawlers , a new collaboration with Final Fantasy 7 . Unlike Cloud's outfit, which is based on the Final Fantasy 7: Advent Children design and has been in the game for ages, these two are based on the FF7 remake project. To get them and many other FF7 -themed cosmetics and items, you must survive the typing brawls and earn a special currency.

Below, you can find all the information you need to learn how to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in FFXIV .

You can only obtain Tifa and Barret's outfit by participating in the Keybound Brawler event , which runs from Oct. 28, until the release of Final Fantasy 14 's patch 8.0 with the Evercold expansion (which should be in January).

The only prerequisites for participating in the event are reaching level 15 , completing one of the following main scenario quests: "The Gridanian Envoy," "The Ul'dahn Envoy," or "The Lominsan Envoy", and unlocking the Gold Saucer . As one might expect given the name, you also need a keyboard to play this game.

Image: Square Enix via Polygon By winning matches during the event, you earn the Manderville Gold Saucer Credits (MGC), which you can exchange for the outfits at the MGC Trader in the Keybound Square. This currency is different from the Manderville Gold Saucer Points (MGP), which you obtain by participating in the regular Gold Saucer's activities.

To purchase all four pieces of Tifa's outfit , you will need 1,380 MGC , and for Barret's five pieces , you'll need 1,570 MGC (I'm not considering both the Avalanche Brawler's Earring and the Avalanche Leader's Earring in these sums). If you complete all three waves of a brawl, you can earn from 200-340 MGC depending on your final score . This means that you will need six to 12 matches to earn enough credits to purchase all the pieces of both outfits.

Keep in mind that the outfits are gender locked when deciding which ones to prioritize.

Graphic: Paulo Kawanishi/Polygon | Source images: Square Enix via Polygon While the Keybound Brawler event is taking place, you can start it by traveling to the Gold Saucer in Thanalan and talking to the Catlike Mammet (5.4, 7.0) to accept the "Keyward Bound" side quest .

Next, you will need to talk to W'zazanh at the Wonder Square (6.1, 7.3) to enter the Keybound Square. Once inside, interact with the Magitype Master behind the counter to complete the quest. Since there are no crystals to teleport to the area, you will always need to talk to W'zazanh to return the Keybound Square in the future.

Graphic: Paulo Kawanishi/Polygon | Source images: Square Enix via Polygon To play Keybound Brawler matches, you need to talk to the Keybound Registrar NPC (5.8, 6.0) . While it's possible to queue as a group, you can also go solo and wait for the game to find party members for you.

Each match is divided into three waves, during which enemies will try to approach the barrier in front of your party. If they reach it, enemies will attack the barrier, lowering your party's HP bar. To attack them, you must correctly type the words that appear above them. Pay attention because, although you don't need to distinguish between uppercase and lowercase, both punctuation and accents count . If enemies deplete your party's HP bar, you will fail the brawl.

Image: Square Enix via Polygon By simply participating in a match, you will earn some MGC, but your score and the number of waves you survive affect the final amount. If you complete the last wave, in addition to MGC and MGP, you also earn a keybound coffer . These can contain various rewards, from food to weapons like the Adamant Rod.

The Keybound Brawler event offers all kinds of rewards, ranging from the two Tifa and Barret's outfits to the unique mount Magitek Scorpion. You can only obtain these rewards by exchanging MGC except for the aforementioned coffers, which you also earn whenever you defeat the third wave's boss.

items.content:
Keybound Brawler, a new event that tests your typing prowess, is coming to the Manderville Gold Saucer! The first iteration of the event will be a special collaboration with the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE series. Participate in the collaboration stages to obtain MGC which can be exchanged for numerous rewards, including collaboration attire, a mount, emote, and more!

Event Duration

From Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 19:00 (AEDT) to the release of Patch 8.0 * The end date listed on Steam does not reflect the release date for Patch 8.0.

How to Participate

Begin the quest "Keyward Bound" by speaking to the Catlike Mammet in The Gold Saucer (X:5.4 Y:7.0). * Players must be level 15 and above to start the quest. * Players must first complete one of the following main scenario quests: "The Gridanian Envoy," "The Ul'dahn Envoy," or "The Lominsan Envoy." * Players must first complete the quest "It Could Happen to You" to be able to travel to the Manderville Gold Saucer via airship from any of the three city-states. * Please note that a keyboard is required to participate in this content. Gamepads and on-screen keyboards cannot be used.

Rewards

* After this collaboration event has ended, it will be held as a special event at irregular intervals. Visit the special site for more details.
